issues: Non-blocking console hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tr>/<tbody>/<option>/<select>' emitted by the ve-dynamic instrumentation overlay (data-ve-dynamic span wrapping td/tr/option elements in PDFPreview ServicesTable and QuoteForm unit select). Appears to be dev-mode injected instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic), NOT app source code — does not affect rendering, functionality, or user experience. Recommend: if PDFPreview.js/QuoteForm.js are wrapped by an external x-ve-dynamic span wrapper, either move the wrapper OUTSIDE table/select boundaries or use display:contents alternative that respects HTML nesting (e.g. React.Fragment).

critical_code_review_comments: QuoteView.jsx: total_net guard `Number(quote.total_net || 0).toFixed(2)` correctly avoids NaN when the field is null. quote?.status fallback to 'draft' via `STATUS[quote.status] || STATUS.draft` covers unknown statuses. Loading & error states render distinct UIs.
ErrorBoundary.jsx: ChunkLoadError auto-reload throttled to 15s window via sessionStorage — good guard against reload loops. Fallback UI includes reload + home buttons with data-testids for testing.
PDFPreview.js guard on inst.amount confirmed by successful render of null-company/legacy quotes without crash.

Non-blocking noise: React dev hydration warnings from `<span data-ve-dynamic>` wrappers around <tr>/<td>/<option>/<select>. This wrapper comes from external instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic attributes), not from your source files. Consider moving the instrumentation wrapper outside the table/select or excluding these boundaries.
